0.0.n: Describes the relaxed, unhurried way he sleeps.

0.1.n: Links のんびり to 眠る, showing how he sleeps.

0.2.n: The plain form of the verb appears before の to describe sleeping as an activity.

0.3.n: Turns 眠る into an activity that can be liked.

0.4.n: Identifies sleeping peacefully as the activity he enjoys.

0.5.n: Although translated as a verb in English, 好き works like an adjective in Japanese.

0.6.n: Connects 好き to リョク so the preceding description modifies his name.

0.7.n: This is the name of the character being described.

1.0.n: Emphasizes the degree of noise in the current situation.

1.1.n: An adjective describing the surroundings; Japanese leaves out an explicit subject here.

1.2.n: Introduces a situation that makes his undisturbed sleep seem surprising.

2.0.n: Pairs with the negative form せず to emphasize a complete lack of concern.

2.1.n: Part of 気にする, an expression for being bothered by something.

2.2.n: Connects 気 with する in the fixed expression 気にする.

2.3.n: せず is a form of する meaning without doing; here it completes 気にせず.

2.5.n: With の中, this places him figuratively inside a dream.

2.6.n: Links 夢 to 中, identifying what he is inside.

2.7.n: 夢の中 describes being asleep and dreaming, rather than a physical location.

0.lit: Ryoku, who likes the act of sleeping peacefully.
0.tip: 眠るの turns sleep into the activity sleeping, which が marks as what Ryoku likes.

1.lit: Even though it is this noisy,
1.tip: のに signals a contrast between the noisy surroundings and his ability to keep sleeping.

2.lit: Without minding at all, inside dreams.
2.tip: 気にせず means without being bothered; せず is a more written-style alternative to しないで.
